```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(drc)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

# Generate a more realistic dataset
set.seed(123)
data <- expand.grid(
  species = c("VV", "VM"),
  individual = 1:5,
  temperature = c(20, 30, 34, 38, 42, 46, 50, 54),
  exposure_time = c(5, 10, 15, 20)
)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(FvFm = case_when(
    temperature == 20 ~ runif(1, 0.75, 0.8),
    temperature == 30 ~ runif(1, 0.75, 0.8),
    temperature == 34 ~ runif(1, 0.7, 0.75),
    temperature == 38 ~ runif(1, 0.65, 0.7),
    temperature == 42 ~ runif(1, 0.6, 0.65),
    temperature == 46 ~ runif(1, 0.55, 0.6),
    temperature == 50 ~ runif(1, 0.1, 0.2),
    temperature == 54 ~ runif(1, 0, 0.05)
  ))

# Fit the four-parameter logistic model for each species
fit_model <- function(species_data) {
  drm(FvFm ~ temperature, data = species_data, fct = LL.4(names = c("Slope", "Lower", "Upper", "ED50")))
}

# Predict T50 and T95
predict_ED <- function(model) {
  ED(model, c(50, 95))
}

# Calculate TCrit
calculate_TCrit <- function(model, max_FvFm) {
  T50 <- ED(model, 50)[1]
  slope <- coef(model)[1]
  intercept <- max_FvFm - slope * T50
  TCrit <- (max_FvFm - intercept) / slope
  return(TCrit)
}

# Apply the model fitting and predictions for each species
results <- data.frame()
for (species in unique(data$species)) {
  species_data <- filter(data, species == !!species)
  model <- fit_model(species_data)
  max_FvFm <- max(species_data$FvFm)
  ED_values <- predict_ED(model)
  TCrit <- calculate_TCrit(model, max_FvFm)
  
  results <- bind_rows(results, data.frame(
    species = species,
    T50 = ED_values[1],
    T95 = ED_values[2],
    TCrit = TCrit
  ))
}

# Plotting the results
ggplot(data, aes(x = temperature, y = FvFm, color = as.factor(exposure_time))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "nls", formula = y ~ SSlogis(x, Asym, xmid, scal), se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  geom_vline(data = results, aes(xintercept = T50, color = "T50"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(data = results, aes(xintercept = T95, color = "T95"), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(data = results, aes(xintercept = TCrit, color = "TCrit"), linetype = "solid") +
  labs(color = "Exposure Time") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T50" = "blue", "T95" = "red", "TCrit" = "green"))


```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(drc)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(boot)

# Generate a more realistic dataset
set.seed(123)
data <- expand.grid(
  species = c("VV", "VM"),
  individual = 1:5,
  temperature = c(20, 30, 34, 38, 42, 46, 50, 54),
  exposure_time = c(5, 10, 15, 20)
)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(FvFm = case_when(
    temperature == 20 ~ runif(1, 0.75, 0.8),
    temperature == 30 ~ runif(1, 0.75, 0.8),
    temperature == 34 ~ runif(1, 0.7, 0.75),
    temperature == 38 ~ runif(1, 0.65, 0.7),
    temperature == 42 ~ runif(1, 0.6, 0.65),
    temperature == 46 ~ runif(1, 0.55, 0.6),
    temperature == 50 ~ runif(1, 0.1, 0.2),
    temperature == 54 ~ runif(1, 0, 0.05)
  ))

# Fit the four-parameter logistic model for each individual
fit_model <- function(individual_data) {
  drm(FvFm ~ temperature, data = individual_data, fct = LL.4(names = c("Slope", "Lower", "Upper", "ED50")))
}

# Predict T50 and T95
predict_ED <- function(model) {
  ED(model, c(50, 95))
}

# Calculate TCrit
calculate_TCrit <- function(model, max_FvFm) {
  T50 <- ED(model, 50)[1]
  slope <- coef(model)[1]
  intercept <- max_FvFm - slope * T50
  TCrit <- (max_FvFm - intercept) / slope
  return(TCrit)
}

# Bootstrap function to estimate T50, T95, and TCrit
bootstrap_estimates <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  model <- fit_model(d)
  max_FvFm <- max(d$FvFm)
  ED_values <- predict_ED(model)
  TCrit <- calculate_TCrit(model, max_FvFm)
  return(c(T50 = ED_values[1], T95 = ED_values[2], TCrit = TCrit))
}

# Apply the model fitting and predictions for each individual
results <- data.frame()
for (species in unique(data$species)) {
  for (exposure_time in unique(data$exposure_time)) {
    for (individual in unique(data$individual)) {
      individual_data <- filter(data, species == !!species, exposure_time == !!exposure_time, individual == !!individual)
      model <- fit_model(individual_data)
      max_FvFm <- max(individual_data$FvFm)
      ED_values <- predict_ED(model)
      TCrit <- calculate_TCrit(model, max_FvFm)
      
      results <- bind_rows(results, data.frame(
        species = species,
        exposure_time = exposure_time,
        individual = individual,
        T50 = ED_values[1],
        T95 = ED_values[2],
        TCrit = TCrit
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Bootstrap estimates for each species and exposure time
bootstrap_results <- data.frame()
for (species in unique(data$species)) {
  for (exposure_time in unique(data$exposure_time)) {
    species_data <- filter(data, species == !!species, exposure_time == !!exposure_time)
    boot_estimates <- boot(data = species_data, statistic = bootstrap_estimates, R = 1000)
    boot_summary <- data.frame(
      species = species,
      exposure_time = exposure_time,
      T50_mean = mean(boot_estimates$t[, 1]),
      T50_ci_lower = quantile(boot_estimates$t[, 1], 0.025),
      T50_ci_upper = quantile(boot_estimates$t[, 1], 0.975),
      T95_mean = mean(boot_estimates$t[, 2]),
      T95_ci_lower = quantile(boot_estimates$t[, 2], 0.025),
      T95_ci_upper = quantile(boot_estimates$t[, 2], 0.975),
      TCrit_mean = mean(boot_estimates$t[, 3]),
      TCrit_ci_lower = quantile(boot_estimates$t[, 3], 0.025),
      TCrit_ci_upper = quantile(boot_estimates$t[, 3], 0.975)
    )
    bootstrap_results <- bind_rows(bootstrap_results, boot_summary)
  }
}

# Plotting the results
ggplot(data, aes(x = temperature, y = FvFm, color = as.factor(exposure_time))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "nls", formula = y ~ SSlogis(x, Asym, xmid, scal), se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  geom_vline(data = results, aes(xintercept = T50, color = "T50"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(data = results, aes(xintercept = T95, color = "T95"), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(data = results, aes(xintercept = TCrit, color = "TCrit"), linetype = "solid") +
  labs(color = "Exposure Time") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T50" = "blue", "T95" = "red", "TCrit" = "green")) +
  ggtitle("Thermal Tolerance Curves with T50, T95, and TCrit")

# Plotting bootstrap results
ggplot(bootstrap_results, aes(x = exposure_time, y = T50_mean, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = T50_ci_lower, ymax = T50_ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bootstrap Estimates of T50", y = "T50 (°C)", x = "Exposure Time (minutes)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(bootstrap_results, aes(x = exposure_time, y = T95_mean, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = T95_ci_lower, ymax = T95_ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bootstrap Estimates of T95", y = "T95 (°C)", x = "Exposure Time (minutes)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(bootstrap_results, aes(x = exposure_time, y = TCrit_mean, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = TCrit_ci_lower, ymax = TCrit_ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bootstrap Estimates of TCrit", y = "TCrit (°C)", x = "Exposure Time (minutes)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
